svg.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: A17bi and A17b on the toy routing
svg.desc: The backend converts addr_k into stick addresses (A17bi), then A17b stores each token's constant id stick once per selected expert into tok_dst. Slots that are not written keep the pad token.
svg.text: A17bi idx2Addr (inserted by the backend): int32 (input fp32)
addr_k → B + slot, B = base of tok_dst
broadcast over K; each stored K times
tok_dst after A17b: one stick store per real (token, expert) pair, none into a sink
(65,536 stores at real size); unwritten slots keep the pad token
